snippet.title: ⚾️승리 요정 tripleS 김채연의 야구 치어리더 도전기! [성수기 EP.31] | KBO | 야구 | 치어리더 | 시구 | LG트윈스
snippet.description:

그 중에서도 우리 MC 채연이가 야구의 꽃인
‘치어리더’를 체험해봤는데요!

LG 트윈스의 일일 치어리더로 합류해 응원과 시구까지하고 왔습니다👏🏻👏🏻👏🏻
승리 요정으로 거듭났던 그 날의 생생한 비하인드와 함께
야구의 매력에 흠뻑 빠져봅시다!

en-US.description:
Make every day of the year as fun and hot as peak season! [Peak Season]

The sport that comes to mind when you think of ‘Spring,’ which recorded 12 million spectators last year!

We went to enjoy ⚾️Baseball⚾️, a sport that is truly in season these days.

In particular, our MC Chaeyeon tried out the flower of baseball,

a ‘cheerleader’!

She joined the LG Twins as a one-day cheerleader and performed everything from cheering to throwing the ceremonial first pitch👏🏻👏🏻👏🏻

Let’s dive into the charm of baseball along with the vivid behind-the-scenes stories of that day when she was reborn as a victory fairy!
